title: CIV Instance Metadata Contract
description: Defines the integration contract between CIV provisioner and downstream test suites. The top-level object is a map of instance identifiers (e.g. OpenTofu resource addresses) to instance metadata objects.

instance.description: Metadata for a single provisioned cloud instance.

name.description: Human-readable instance name, typically derived from the OpenTofu resource name.

address.description: Network address used for SSH connections. Resolved from public_dns, public_ip, or private_ip in order of preference.

username.description: SSH login username for the instance (e.g. 'ec2-user', 'cloud-user').

image.description: Cloud image reference used to launch the instance. String on most clouds; may be an object on Azure (source_image_reference).

region.description: Cloud region where the instance is running (e.g. 'us-east-1').

image_id.description: Cloud-specific image identifier (e.g. AMI ID, image URN).
